entry.title: Aljaž Tower
entry.note: Exact-QID mapped circle supplies the cylinder location, but its polygon axis is not an entrance bearing. The 2018 conservation report confirms the original rotation was preserved; it does not publish that angle. A directed doorway bearing must be independently resolved before automatic geographic activation. Do not use the arbitrary minimum-area axis of a near-circular OSM footprint. The model is available for asset review and explicit host placement while the doorway compass registration is pending. Draft is discoverable but never rendered; resolve the recorded placement uncertainty before activation.
